title: PublicationReceipt
description:
Durable proof that exactly one owner published a workflow result.

Compatibility contract: v0.3+ consumers accept schema
`animus.publication-receipt.v1`, version `1`. Unknown schema ids or versions
fail closed. Older v0.2 consumers ignore the additive optional receipt field
on runner results, but MUST NOT be used for workflows whose publication is
required because they cannot verify this proof.

commit_sha.description: Commit SHA produced by the workflow.

issuer.description: Exact owner/component that issued this receipt.

observed_remote_sha.description: SHA independently observed at `remote_ref` after publication.

pull_request.description: Pull-request proof when the publication policy requires a PR.

recovery_ref.description: Durable ref from which unpublished/recovery work can be restored.

remote.description: Canonical remote URL used for publication.

remote_ref.description: Fully qualified remote ref, for example `refs/heads/animus/TASK-1173`.

subject.description: Qualified subject/task and its leased generation.

tree_sha.description: Git tree SHA for the published commit.

workflow_generation.description: Workflow generation fenced into the publication lease.

PublicationPullRequest.description: Pull-request proof attached to a publication receipt.

head_sha.description: Head SHA observed from the pull request provider after create/update.

PublicationReceiptIssuer.description: Component that issued a publication receipt.

oneOf.description: A named workflow phase owns publication.

component.description: Component or command implementation that emitted the receipt.

phase_id.description: Phase id declared by the workflow publication contract.

PublicationSubjectGeneration.description:
Qualified subject identity and generation fenced into a publication.

`qualified_id` uses the canonical `<kind>:<native-id>` shape (for example
`task:TASK-1173`). `generation` is the subject generation leased for this
execution; a receipt for an older generation must never satisfy a newer run.

generation.description: Subject generation leased by this workflow execution.
